title: Architecture
subtitle: Target architecture · components and interactions
implementationUnconfirmed: Full implementation has not been confirmed. Some code may already exist.
documentationHint: The document is generated from the currently loaded JSON model. Edit the model and regenerate the description.

document.generated: Generated by Archivarius from the architecture JSON model. Edit the source model and regenerate this document. It describes target architecture; format validation does not establish code conformance.

hints.zoom: Scroll to zoom and reveal parts
hints.edge: Click an arrow for its contents

partsNote: Zoom reveals understood parts. The decomposition is not claimed to be exhaustive.
interpretationNote: An interpretation of the target architecture. Implementation confirmation covers the entire described block contract.
aggregateNote: This arrow represents a shared interaction channel. Its original transfers appear below.
specifiedNote: At this scale the participant may be represented by its parent. The original interaction appears below.
relationNote: An arrow describes a target interaction, not execution order. An aggregate is fully implemented only if every original transfer is confirmed.
rulesIntro: Rules for the data model, views and levels of detail.
incompleteNote: The map may be incomplete. Node counts and depth do not measure system readiness.
aboutSteps: Scroll to reveal nested components. Drag to move the map.
Double-click a block to explore it. Click once for inputs, outputs and rules.
An arrow shows its original interactions and lets you navigate to their participants.
The inspector shows Fully implemented: yes / no. No means full implementation has not been confirmed; yes requires verification of the whole described contract.
Emphasizing a type keeps other interactions visible in gray.
Search jumps to any component. Rules and properties appear in its inspector, not as separate components.
Breadcrumbs, the minimap and the home button return you to context.
While the map has focus, + / − zoom, Home shows the overview and Escape closes details or moves up.
aboutNote: The map describes an understood target architecture. Detail stops at a known external contract where internals have not been studied.
technicalNote: React Flow · ELK.js. Geometry is calculated when a model loads and stays fixed during zoom.
